defects.scenario: Two concurrent POSTs to /api/public/customer/submit with identical clientEmail within 16ms
defects.expected: Only one project created; second request returns existing project or conflict response
defects.actual: Two separate projects created: 9f27053c-8037-474f-9d54-2ebbe023503c and 5ddc4366-2dbe-4ad1-b7f5-f8f95b48b26c, each with distinct reviewToken and dashboardToken
defects.evidence: Concurrent curl PIDs both returned HTTP 201 with different projectIds and tokens; timestamps 2026-07-23T15:55:21.594Z and 2026-07-23T15:55:21.614Z (20ms apart)
defects.rootCauseCandidate: No deduplication window or idempotency key on /api/public/customer/submit. The handler inserts immediately without checking for a recent pending submission from same email.
defects.releaseImpact: Duplicate projects for the same customer email; potential double billing and confusing customer experience.

defects.evidence: curl -H 'x-admin-api-key: <valid>' /api/internal/auth/me → {"error":"Not authenticated"}; same endpoint with no key → 401 (different response)
defects.rootCauseCandidate: The /api/internal/auth/me endpoint resolves identity from session cookie (internalAuthService session), not from API key. Admin API key auth and internal user session auth are separate mechanisms.
defects.releaseImpact: Admin UI panels that call /api/internal/auth/me via session may fail if session is not established. API key-authenticated admin flows are unaffected.

defects.expected: Notification items contain populated `type` and `tenantId` fields
defects.actual: notification.type = undefined, notification.tenantId = undefined for all 3 notification items
defects.evidence: Node -e log: items.forEach(n => console.log(n.type, n.tenantId)) printed 'undefined undefined' for all 3 notifications. notification.title was correctly 'E2E Brand Alpha'.
defects.rootCauseCandidate: The notification serializer/mapper omits the `type` column from the SELECT or maps it under a different key (e.g., `notificationType`). Public route may intentionally strip tenantId.
defects.releaseImpact: Customer Portal cannot render notification-type icons or filter by notification type. Low visibility impact.
